info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Knowledge Assets Management Manual By Management Manual Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows for updates to existing Banking Knowledge Assets Management Manuals based on their unique identifiers. It enables organizations to manage and modify critical documentation efficiently, ensuring that the content remains current and relevant. Typical consumers include financial institutions and compliance teams that need to maintain accurate knowledge assets. By using this API, developers can programmatically adjust the content of management manuals to reflect changes in policies or regulations, thereby enhancing the overall governance of banking practices.
